resources.name: BerkantACUN/ifc-ruhsat
resources.description_en: Checks an IFC building model against Türkiye's building-permit BIM regulation (Official Gazette 33331, in force Sept 2027): mandatory IFC 4.3 classes and category codes, per-class attribute and property-set requirements (all 68 annex tables, incl. the Türkiye-specific TREpys_ sets), TUREF coordinate system, naming templates and space geometry — and fills in the regulation's 21-row Annex-9 quality-control form. Findings cite the article and annex table with GlobalIds; rows a machine cannot verify are reported as manual, never as passed. Also exports buildingSMART IDS. uvx ifc-ruhsat mcp; on the official registry as io.github.BerkantACUN/ifc-ruhsat.

resources.name: inth3shadows/terse
resources.description_en: Transparent proxy that sits in front of any other MCP server and shrinks its tool output before it reaches the model. Lossless by default — a denser encoding of the same bytes, with a round-trip gate asserting an exact inverse, so nothing is dropped or summarised. Repeated calls to the same tool emit a delta against the prior result instead of the whole payload. Per-tool opt-in, no decode step, no model in the loop. uv tool install terse-mcp then terse proxy --

sources.raw_text: - [inth3shadows/terse](https://github.com/inth3shadows/terse) [![inth3shadows/terse MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/inth3shadows/terse/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/inth3shadows/terse) 🐍 🏠 🍎 🪟 🐧 - Transparent proxy that sits in front of any other MCP server and shrinks its tool output before it reaches the model. Lossless by default — a denser encoding of the same bytes, with a round-trip gate asserting an exact inverse, so nothing is dropped or summarised. Repeated calls to the same tool emit a delta against the prior result instead of the whole payload. Per-tool opt-in, no decode step, no model in the loop. `uv tool install terse-mcp` then `terse proxy -- <server>`

resources.name: DevHusnainAi/zerodom
resources.description_en: Deterministic attack-surface perception for AI security agents. Attaches over chrome.debugger to the Chrome you're already logged into (cookies, MFA and SSO already done) and turns the live page into a short numbered interaction graph an agent can act on ([03] button 'Sign In'), with CSS selectors kept server-side and out of the model's context. Cross-identity tools (compare_identities, replay) flag a byte-identical response across two logged-in users as a cross-tenant IDOR, and scan maps the attack surface from the CLI. No LLM in the parse; 71% fewer tokens than Playwright's ARIA snapshot mode.

Cross-identity tools (`compare_identities`, `replay`) flag a byte-identical response across two logged-in users as a cross-tenant IDOR, and `scan` maps the attack surface from the CLI.
